## Changes

- Added Minecraft 26.3 support, including its expanded entity-collision query during step-up movement and chunk-ticking-dependent entity pushability.
- Added a Minecraft 26.1 build. Minecraft 26.2 retains the alpha.7 collision behavior and now includes the shared exception-handling improvements.
- Minecraft 26.1, 26.2, and 26.3 now retain native exception details in Java error reports, propagate fatal errors without ordinary exception wrapping, and skip catch-based recovery cleanup for fatal errors.
- Added regression coverage for elevated hard colliders, ticking-state changes, and native error propagation.
- Introduced branch-based continuous delivery: `main` creates the shared release, and Minecraft version branches append their tested builds to it.

## Downloads

Choose the JAR matching your Minecraft version. Version-branch assets are appended after their builds and tests pass; they may appear after the initial release.

Each JAR includes Windows, Linux, and macOS x86-64 native libraries. Java 25, Fabric Loader, a matching Fabric API, and an AVX2-capable x86-64 processor are required.

Per-version SHA-256 checksums and source-commit records accompany each build. Connecting clients do not need this server-side mod.
